nodes.name: Form Trigger
nodes.notes: Standalone test harness (ADR-020): paste a ClickUp task id; fetches its attachments and runs the reader. When Called is the real entry from input-router (Block 4).

parameters.formDescription: Enter a ClickUp task id to extract its text attachments.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow entry (called by input-router, Block 4). In: { clickup_task_id }. Out: { blocks, clickup_task_id }. Self-fetches + self-filters attachments to the text family (xlsx/docx/csv/txt). Empty case (no text files) returns no items.

nodes.name: Get Task
nodes.notes: Authoritative attachment list + signed download URLs (ADR-019 credential-aware fetch). Returns full raw task incl attachments[] (the n8n ClickUp 'get' node omits attachments). A hard fetch failure throws -> global Error Handler (v1) CRITICAL (there is nothing to extract).

nodes.name: Filter Text Attachments
nodes.notes: Pure shaping: keep xlsx/docx/csv/txt by extension or mimetype, preserve order, one item per attachment. No matches -> 0 items (reader returns nothing; caller treats as no text blocks).

nodes.name: Fetch Attachment Binary
nodes.notes: Download bytes to a binary property (kept separate from JSON - no base64 in the flow). ClickUp url_w_query is pre-signed, so no auth header. continueRegularOutput: a fetch failure stays inline (no binary) so Docling/Build Block degrade it to [BRAK] + WARN.

nodes.name: Docling Convert
nodes.notes: POST /v1/convert/file (multipart field 'files'). image_export_mode=placeholder is CRITICAL (default 'embedded' inlines base64 and explodes token cost - ADR-036 Block 1). Note: a corrupt file returns HTTP 200 with status=failure + md_content=null, so Build Block checks md_content, not the HTTP code. continueRegularOutput keeps real HTTP errors inline -> [BRAK].

nodes.name: Build Block
nodes.notes: Per-item: success -> { type:text, order, md }; any failure (fetch error, Docling error, or 200/status=failure/empty md) -> [BRAK: extraction_failed <file>] + needs_alert. Flags has_embedded on placeholder markers. Single output -> Aggregate has exactly one input (runs once over all items).

nodes.name: Aggregate Blocks
nodes.notes: Sole terminal (single input from Build Block -> runs once over all items): collect every .block, sort by order, return { blocks, clickup_task_id }.

nodes.name: Alert Extraction Failed
nodes.notes: Per-file WARN through the Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025). Closes the Block-1-deferred 'Docling down at request time' silent gap. Dead-end side branch (does not feed Aggregate).

value.message: Docling nie wyodrębnił treści załącznika; wstawiono znacznik [BRAK] i kontynuowano.

nodes.name: Alert Embedded Skipped
nodes.notes: Side-branch WARN (degradation, not failure): embedded in-doc images dropped until Block 10 hosting. Dead-end side branch (does not feed Aggregate).

value.message: Pominięto obraz osadzony w dokumencie (hosting obrazów wejściowych zostanie dodany w Bloku 10).
